source: University of Maryland Schedule of Classes (Testudo)
note: Weighted count of class meetings in progress. Not people. Weights and hour counting match data/class_activity.json. `seats` is the number of students ENROLLED in the sections meeting then (each section's seat total minus the seats still open when Testudo was read), summed over distinct sections. It is a snapshot taken after drop/add and drifts only slowly. Ohio State's `seats` is a room capacity instead.
